notes.title: Steam sale time again! Also, Update progress!
notes.content:
Good day everyone! 

Once again, PONCHO is in the Steam sale! It's currently 40% off, so now's the time to tell your friends or get it yourself if you wish! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/332620/

We're hard at work on a new update, which will fix things like Xbox One Controllers on Windows 10. We're hoping to have it out in the next couple of weeks, we'll keep you posted!

- All of us at Delve Interactive

notes.title: We need reviews!
notes.content:
Good day, Poncho players! 

Things have been going very well so far for Poncho, we currently have a 77% approval rating on steam! But, we're still hurting for exposure. You can help! 

All you have to do is leave us a review on the store page, it'll only take a moment, it helps us immensly and allows us to continue making games! We have a very small number of reviews right now, maybe you could help us out?

Thanks in advance for your help, the next patch for Poncho is coming in the next couple of weeks! We'll keep you posted. ^-^

- All of us at Delve Interactive

notes.title: UPDATE PATCH 4!
notes.content:
Hey guys, so now we've just rolled out our 4th update for Poncho. Here's a list of fixes: 


    Xbox One controllers are now working for PC, but windows 10 users will need to use the driver fix listed in the bugs/suggestions section.

    D-PAD input is fixed!

    Player's using 2 screens will no longer see a black screen on certain platforms. 

  Various tweaks to the gameplay have been made for a better experience.


We hope you enjoy the changes! If you have any issues, please feel free to get in touch. ^-^

notes.title: Update 3 is live!
notes.content:
Hey guys, 

We just rolled out another update for the game, this one tackles all remaining bugs that we know of, including the infamous but rare black screen... 

We've also updated the graphics and controls for the game, have a go and tell us if you like the changes!

Don't forget to post your review! Reviews help us out immensly, and your feedback goes into improving the game even more. It'll only take a moment, write a review or recommendation today! :D 

We're working on Xbox One controller support and windowed mode now, we'll have that update out soon.

notes.title: 1st Update is live! Bugs Fixed!
notes.content:
Hi guys, 

In less than 22 hours since launch, we've managed to put together an update addressing all your concerns! This update comes with a bunch of tweaks and bug fixes, including: 

 
     Fixed Startup/launch issues on certain versions of windows!
     "Tribe" level now has improved respawns! (You don't have to start from the bottom).
     Can no longer go backwards in the lab area and cause issues!
     Fixed a bug where the screen would go dark in certain areas of "The overgrown remnants"!
     Fixed Camera controls in "The Great Lake"!
     Various other tweaks and small bug fixes!


I hope you continue to enjoy our game! If you play Poncho and discover any new issues, please feel free to comment here or create a discussion thread.
